- [markdownBridge.mjs](/output/lib/markdownBridge.mjs) uses Node’s built-in `child_process` to call `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` for exact Markdown parity with the Python behavior.
- [runCli.mjs](/output/lib/runCli.mjs) ties parsing and rendering together and returns the correct exit code.
